content:
(if I could get the seed's identification sent to me I'd appreciate)
Kukudh flies back in. `Delivery successful. Now for the execution.`

"My town was much smaller and not in the middle of a war, I suppose. Especially that redcoats are now plotting something over in Feytown. We don't know enough details yet, but it could be an obstacle on our mission to restore the cornerstones."
he nods
(or even just drop the identification here since Kukudh will be passing on the info anyway, actually)

"All four of us have made some allies there, who also value secrecy, and respect that we have our secrets to keep. But, the redcoats have been making camps pretty in the open by the ports, so even for any passerby it's clear something's brewing up there."
"From what I've gathered, so far those allies are not focusing their attention on the cornerstones."
`...alright, that wasn't the info I was expecting, but it's info - can't pick up any properties from it, so it's probably not magical.`
"So what, is it like, an engineered plant?"
`Iunno. She'll stick around for a bit, especially since *He*'s also there, see if we can pick anything up.`
"Did she really just what, stay right under their noses and do identifying magic? I wish I was half as brave."
`Well, she wasn't exactly in sight. Talking with Liz about weird stuff living people had to do, good opportunity to complain about bathrooms, right?`
"Can't argue with that."

"So, we have the Umbral Cup preparations in place, locating the cornerstone in Kingsbridge might have to wait till after that, we have suspicious apple tree seeds, and redcoats planning something bad. I think that might cover the progress report so far?"
"Sounds about right... "

"I suppose normally I'd ask what we should do, but I think we already have more than enough things to do. Preparation for Umbral Cup, keeping an eye on redcoats, keeping an eye on those seeds, likely in that order. Mender, is there anything else we should know of that happened recently and might be important for our tasks on hand?"
"We will be setting a stone in Kingsbridge the moment we know the cup is cleansed"(afk for a bit)
`Got any words for that one? Guessing something to do with memory and thought and life, given the Ravens.`
"Probably. I guess in that case we won't need to find the original cornerstone, and we'd use another one like what Franklin set up here in the park?"
"We should figure out what needs to be written on the stone so we can write as soon as it's cleansed."

"Good point. Hopefully the Ravens can let us know what they want on the cornerstone without the whole making a deal with them for the information. Mender, have they said anything about that so far? You did get to talk with them last time you went to Kingsbridge, if I recall correctly."
"yes... I gave them something to make sure their will and their town are protected by the best words possible"

`...can I ask what you gave them? We probably could have found something - we don't have many memories, but surely this is something important enough to them to get completed that they'd take something lesser, right?`
"What was was given is not important right now "
`...you're right. I'm sorry.`
they look a lot more serious than usual.
"What's important is the cooperation with the ravens to protect not just Kingsbridge but all of Empire City"
"For unity. So, does that mean that when the Cup is cleansed, the Ravens will just let us know what should get inscribed?"
"I hope they give it to us before. That way there is no time lapse between the cleansing and the scribing on the stone."
`Ah, I'll be back momentarily. I have to pick up the potion for the Umbral Cup force.` they fly out.
"My point was mostly can we count on getting the words right away when we need them."
"Does Irynx, their priestess, know, and should she?"
Ed shrugs

(sorry like i said had to go afk "Thoughts and memories are both food and poison. The difference between whether they sustain or defeat you is in Veracity and Self Discipline. "Is it true?" and "can I endure the truth of it? "
Thoughts can be intelligence or base cunning. Memories can be wisdom or a prison. 

Let Veracity lead to Wisdom and Wisdom back to truth. Let us not be divided on the surety of either. Let your thoughts and memories cause others to rise as you rise."
Kukudh flies back in. `Alright, delivery made for the UC team.`
`Sab's chatting with *Him* right now, if we're done here before she is I'll come back and drop a note. Dunno how she stands it, honestly, he called me a 'very fit pigeon' in a sort of creepy way.`
"Few things he does are not in a creepy way. So, that sounds like we have the general idea, but would need to condense it down like with the park's stone, right?"
`...alright, urgent, *He's* asked Sab to assist Liz with something. She's considering going to build trust and gain info. If there's any objections, I'll go outside and send her a message.`
"... is Sab going alone?"
`It's something that'll get done whether or not she's there - no, she's going with Liz and maybe Dox.`
`If so, I'll stick with Roy to relay info - if she dies I'll disappear, so I should be relaying in real-time.`
"That would then be how many errands done for him?"
"I recall something being mentioned at three without what it is"
`I think two? Possibly three if she went on one while I was dead, but...`
`Worst-case scenario, I'll let you know whatever I can - I can block myself off from her if needed.`
`Might not survive long if I do, but it'll be enough to get you info.`
"If she's going, tell her to be careful."
`Got it.` they fly outside the cottage to send the message, then back in. `She says thanks, and that she will.`
"Shall we get back to the Voice for the time being, then? Or do we need to decide on how to phrase the inscription right now?"
Fuddles nods

"Thoughts and memories are both food and poison. The difference between whether they sustain or defeat you is in Veracity and Self Discipline. "Is it true?" and "can I endure the truth of it? "
Thoughts can be intelligence or base cunning. Memories can be wisdom or a prison. 

Let Veracity lead to Wisdom and Wisdom back to truth. Let us not be divided on the surety of either. Let your thoughts and memories cause others to rise as you rise."
"its what the ravens told me
`Will all that fit, though?`
"ITs a large stone
"So a bigger stone should be able to hold more words? I thought maybe it's something per each stone, like how we had to shorten the hope and unity one."
"I was gonig off the stone we knew"
"Do we have a stone ready for Kingsbridge?"
Ed just listens in and takes out some more toast from their pocket to eat
"not yet.... need a hard and durable stone"
"Would we have any issues if we cleanse the Cup, but don't immediately inscribe on a new stone? Because I suppose we'd still need to find one."
Kukudh goes over to the notes and starts writing. `Some poem to interact with a giant frog. Might be useful to know.`
"nope.... cleansing the cup is just what they said was needed"

"The heart of any town is the cup from which it drinks. Cleanse the umbral cup and set the stone there that the people might once again begin to see kingsbridge as a home rather than just the last outpost before the Noir."
"I see. If only I had noticed that sooner. Well, so for now it all comes back to cleansing the Cup being the first thing on the list. We should continue our preparations."
"Ed, Fuddles, Kukudh, shall we head back then? We'll need to gather people, and I have a few potions to brew for yall."
`There's someone hurt in the alleys of Hampstead - we should stop by to help them. Roy, got any berries? Sab's all out.`
Fuddles nods "Lets go help."
Kukudh flies out, leading them to <#851195569623007232>.
Fuddles follows
"I can make a few. After you." Roy follows.
Ed follows as well
(btw, just fyi if you don't feel like running decrypt: I absolutely did just drop Never Gonna Give You Up in ooc)

(since I only just got it)
the note Kukudh was writing reads,
```Poem to interact with giant frog, related to *Him*
'...Without word,
Seldom heard,
Banderhobbs creep
From shadows deep
In voiceless night
When stars alight
Upon the bleak and moonless blight...'

Keeping Roy updated with anything further Sab learns to update. ♡ Kukudh```

Kukudh flies back in invisibly, and scrawls another note:

```Frog situation update:

Ran into wounded man en route to frog - frog ate his arm - comes up again later. Sab let me know and I lead us over to help.

Sab, Liz, Dox encountered giant 8-foot frog. Sab recited poem to it, it opened its mouth for them to climb in - Sab and Liz went, Dox stayed outside in case they needed help.

Frog's interior was stony and full of whispers. Sab listened to one:
'It was just a sandwich. Why couldn't she understand that? She knew he'd completely changed his life around her eating habits, so why couldn't she give him a break this one time? She wasn't even supposed to have found out. Yes, he had promised her and yes, he had broken that promise, but still in his mind, all it had been was just a sandwich.'

Liz dropped letter into stone mouth inside frog, and it disappeared. Did not open exit.

No clear exit, but Sab had a hunch and recited poem again, frog opened mouth again. It had moved to the old gallows site.

While that was going on, we encountered a strange tendrilled thing in Hampstead streets while escorting injured man. I managed to distract it so we could get to Ordinary.

Injured man ranted about sanitarium, I went to Voice to get healing potions. Got back just after Sab et al. Man was bleeding and seizing.

Sab and Roy somehow got *Him* to help injured man, was taken to hospital. Sab took book injured man had to look into later.

*He* offered rewards including an apple, Sab took it to identify later under the (completely true) guise of never having had an apple before.

Arm hopefully getting re-attached. Writing this while it happens.

♡ from Kukudh```
after finishing writing, they start to fly back to the hospital.

before remembering a name, and adding on the end, 
```Name dropped - Kellogs? In case anyone knows them.```
they start flying back again.

(putting this here purely so I don't forget to bring it up, though now I look at it again Crane said no specific magical properties but getting a little temporary HP for a bit)
another follow-up note reads:

```Arm got reattached fine. Sab identified apple: no noticeable malevolence, from what she can tell it seems super tasty and glazed in sugar. Would be funny if all along *His* plan was just to cause tooth decay.
♡♡♡ Kukudh```

(I'll just have them leave notes on stuff as appropriate, since that's not really strictly time-based)
Kukudh left another note,

```Chatted with Bo for a bit, and *He* - Mr. Sandwich, why does he even buy so many? - came up slightly. Apparently he saved Bo from some green rock thing? This guy is so confusing.
Apparently Bo's in a pact with some fancy vibrant dragon named Spectra now with the goal of friendship. Mr. Sandwich's involvement here is unknown but Bo seems to be doing well for now. Still same old Bo...

Course I haven't seen everything you have, but we should consider the possibility that we jumped to conclusions a bit. No explanation from here for abandoning the meat-child for us to deal with though.
I'll keep an ear out. One thing for sure, Redcoats are a common enemy, so if we have to team up then the 'enemy of my enemy is my friend' principle should apply for the time.

Making some plans. Will leave an update after.
♡ Kukudh```
Ed is there with some poor attempt of a pie and deposits it at the table before catching up with the new notes.

They leave the pie with the following note 
`Trying my hand at cooking, ended up with too much pie. Not the best but food is good for sharing with friends. No updates from me for now. Ed`
The mender walks in and sees pie.  He happily eats half and goes about his business

Ed drags themselves in to leave the following note 
`Investigation with Sab and Roy about Heore was a *jarring* experience. Sab was the distraction and was killed during one of Heore's experiments involving eeels. I trust Roy took her safely and she can be brought back shortly.  Some of the info we got from Heore was that she had been experimenting on humanoids and who knows what else to create "new life" And there was also something about several of her creatures being chained up in several places in Hampstead and how they are no more than talking animals. She was bragging about all of them being afraid of her and offered to have them all go solve our redcoat problematic. Considering how huge these creatures seem to be and how little regard she had for who got killed or what got destroyed put me in a difficult position. I had to stop her... I had to stop her once and for all. `
`I have my suspicions that Heore murdered her partner 'Frank' and was looking for someone to replace him, and it might have been me if I had not gotten myself out of that situation. I got her journal and some books I took from her lab hidden in my airship The Nimble. Once I can be sure everything is alright, I will bring them over `
`Ed`

The mender enters the cottage and writes a note to Ben Franklin <@!313689699627696139> 
```I now see what you meant by family and unity as a cornerstone.  I will keep that in mind as I continue to set this city on a better course, and hopefully the weak constitution can be amended or replaced with something better soon.

-The Mender```
He once again leaves

```To all my Menders, This week we need to try placing 3 cornerstones.  We know where the Kingsbrige one should go, once the cup is cleansed.  This leaves Feytown and Staaten.  Think about where the heart of Ferrytown is, and what might be right to stabilize it.  Likewise Staaten will require a group to get into the wastes, and find an appropriate place for a stone, and words to help it rebuild and recover.

Think hard and fast on these three tasks, as there is not much time to complete our mission.

-Mender```

```Noted, getting Kukudh to tell the others to come here as and when possible.

Thoughts re: Feytown:
-Cael'fii is an obvious choice,
-Illo'fae could also be good if people passing by it will be important,
-The Hilltops could also do nicely? A lot of the local kids hang out there, childish joy could be a good thing to work with.
I can ask Ferrah etc. if they've got any ideas, we're on good terms.

Don't know much about the Wastes, but perhaps something about building new things from the old? Like Roy's fancy longbow.

-Sab```

Sabrine leaves this note along with a basket of 10 goodberries, and heads back into the park proper.

Roy reads the notes from Mender and Sab, and leaves his own.
```
I didn't get the idea right for Kingsbridge, and going by the same idea for the heart of the borough, Sab's suggestions seem reasonable. The tree is referred to by locals as "the mother", the Isle would be a gathering place, and I could see a reasoning for where the kids live.
But overall we don't have bad relations with people in Feytown, so maybe we can find out more to confirm or rebuke our initial guesses.
As for the idea Feytown should carry, my first thought is that the place is very keen on moving forwards and embracing the change, with many things I've learned about the borough. Not sure if it would be sufficient, but maybe as a starting point.
For Staaten, perhaps we could check out with the team who went there on a mission before.
Kukudh is gathering the rest to come here soon.
-- Roy
```
Roy leaves the cottage.
Sabrine reads over the note Roy left. 'Oh, that's a good point about embracing change.'
Fuddles readsover the notes she has missed
"Might be kinda weak but that's just the first thing I thought of. With people becoming shifters there, and some other things I can think of."
"This suggestions are good sab."
'It's definitely something to look into. I'm just not quite sure how to go about asking what would be good, how much I'm allowed to mention in the process...'

"Also if I recall correctly, Finn and Eliza, and some other people I can't remember, went to Staaten Wastes. We could ask if they recall anything that could help, otherwise we'd need to make an expedition there."
'Kukudh says Eliza's gone on a date, to the gun range, apparently? And Finn also left, but was around so might be nearby.'
'If I can find Mender - I need to talk to him anyway - we can ask him how much we're allowed to disclose when asking Ferrytown council for wording advice.'
The mender enters from <#868812602829049916> while holding a gun.
